rules.sql: SELECT *, topic(3) as asset_id, timestamp() as ingestion_time FROM 'iot/assets/+/telemetry'
rules.description: Routes all live sensor telemetry from edge nodes to the serverless Lambda normalizer

rules.sql: SELECT device_id, alert_type, severity, metrics, timestamp FROM 'iot/alerts/+' WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL'
rules.description: Directly archives critical failure alerts to high-priority audit storage
